name: lorerim-save-connector
description: Reads your Skyrim saves on this PC for the LoreRim Build Planner: level, day, place and quest stages, never the file.
long_description: Your Claude reads your newest Skyrim SE save with the planner's own reader and passes what it found to the planner as where you stand. The save stays on your PC: only the level, XP, day, place, save number and each quest's highest stage leave it.

tools.name: read_latest_save
tools.description: Read the newest save, or a character's newest, and give what it found for set_snapshot.

tools.name: list_saves
tools.description: List the newest saves, by character.

save_folders.title: Save folders
save_folders.description: Where your saves are. The LoreRim folder reads every profile's saves; a saves folder reads just that one.
